hypotheses.claim: Some of Binance's approximately $1.34B in remaining in-kind asset purchases could include XRP and create market or OTC demand.
support: Binance says purchases will be made in the exact affected tokens through market and OTC channels.
XRP was one of the affected assets.
hypotheses.counter_hypothesis: The aggregate could be concentrated in BTC, ETH, stablecoins or other affected assets; no XRP quantity, venue, execution time or price is disclosed.

hypotheses.claim: The October 30 XRP derivatives panel is consistent with a long-led leverage unwind rather than evidence of net spot selling.
support: Liqwall reports 96% of liquidations were longs and negative average funding.
TradRadar independently reports long-dominated liquidations and negative OI-weighted funding.
hypotheses.counter_hypothesis: OI scopes differ materially, account ratios are not notional exposure, and no synchronized spot order-flow panel isolates spot selling.
